title: Mawlid an-Nabi ﷺ
body: Today is the blessed birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

title: Ramadan Mubarak!
body: Ramadan Mubarak! May Allah accept your fasting and worship.

title: Eid al-Fitr
body: Eid Mubarak! May Allah accept your fasting and bless you and your family.

title: Day of Arafah
body: Today is the Day of Arafah. Increase your du'a and fasting if you are not performing Hajj.

title: Eid al-Adha
body: Eid Mubarak! May Allah accept your sacrifices and good deeds.
